가입 시 1,200크레딧을 지급합니다. 이후 30일마다 계정 접속 시 기: Receive 1,200 credits at signup, then 1,200 base credits every 30 days when you access your account. Missed periods do not accumulate. Free credits expire after 30 days. Keeping projects open and reading existing results do not use credits.
크레딧 Plus는 월 $4.99에 1,200크레딧을 추가하는 자동 갱신: Credits Plus auto-renews at $4.99/month and adds 1,200 credits valid through that billing period. Prices are charged in USD and include tax. Card issuer currency-conversion or international fees may apply separately.
Terminal·Auto Space·Research·Present AI는: Terminal, Auto Space, Research, and Present AI use shared credits. Each Terminal request costs 2 credits, each Auto Space AI response costs 5, voice input costs 2, Research investigation costs 60, Research AI management costs 2, and each Present AI image costs 20 credits. Credits are deducted upfront when an operation starts and restored if it fails or is canceled. Research service AI costs are included; costs and usage limits charged by CLI/API providers connected through other features are separate. Creating a Research task is free, and credits are deducted for each automatic or manual investigation. Automatic investigations run while the app is running; if you do not have enough credits, a new run will not start. Period-based and included tasks purchased previously retain the terms for their applicable period.
기존 Research 기간제 Task를 실행당 요금으로 전환하면 남은 기: When converting an existing Research time-based Task to a per-execution charge, prepaid credits corresponding to the remaining-period ratio are restored once, with decimals truncated. Past executions are not billed retroactively. Per-execution credits are feature usage fees, not charges for measured API costs. One retry is available per cycle, and the total number of attempts for the entire period is limited to the scheduled execution count plus 20% (rounded up). Automatic credit renewal for additional tasks applies only when selected, and renewal stops when a task is paused or deleted. Research for missed cycles is not executed retroactively. When a payment is canceled, credits from that payment are reclaimed; if any credits have already been used, account verification may be required. Submit refund requests to Customer Support with the order number. No actual paid top-ups are provided before the official refund standards, subscription cancellation notice, and operator information are finalized.
주식회사 파이누스 (Pinous Cor., Ltd, 이하 “회사”)는 D: Pinous Cor., Ltd (the “Company”) processes the personal information of DOBO website and desktop app users as follows.
서버·백업 업체, 실제 사용할 로그인·이메일·결제 서비스의 위탁 및 국외: After reflecting the details of entrusting and transferring overseas to server and backup providers, and to the actual login, email, and payment services used, we will announce the effective date. 1. 처리 목적·항목 및 수집 방법: 1. Purposes, items, and methods of collection
The company processes personal information to the extent necessary for membership registration and contract performance. Where consent is required for optional processing, separate consent is obtained, and retention required by law is based on the applicable law.
선택한 로그인 제공자의 사용자 식별자, 이름 또는 닉네임, 제공자가 확인: We process the user identifier, name or nickname of the selected login provider, the email address verified by the provider (if provided), the DOBO account identifier, and the signup time. For email login, we use the email address entered. We do not collect external login passwords.
로그인 세션, 인증 요청·만료 시각, 인증용 난수, 요청 횟수와 제한 시: Handles login sessions, authentication requests·expiration times, authentication nonces, request counts, and limit times. The connecting IP is processed during server communication, and a hash of the IP is used in the database for API request limits.
계정 식별자, 지급·차감·환급 내역, 작업 식별자·제목·종류·상태·시각,: We process account identifier; payment, credit issuance, deduction, and refund history; task identifier, title, type, status, and time; and Research task title, schedule, period, renewal settings, and run history. Task titles may include part of the input.
주문 식별자, 상품·통화·금액, 결제·환불·구독 상태, 결제사 거래 식별: We process order identifiers; product, currency, and amount; payment, refund, and subscription status; payment provider transaction identifiers; and usage periods. Card numbers and security codes are handled on the payment provider's screen and are not stored on DOBO account servers.
이용자가 제공한 이메일·연락처, 문의 내용, 필요한 주문·계정 식별 정보: We process the email address and contact information provided by the user, inquiry details, necessary order and account identification information, and processing results. Do not include passwords, card numbers, or API secret keys in your inquiry.
정보는 회원의 직접 입력, 선택한 로그인 제공자의 인증 응답, 앱과 서버: Information is collected through direct input from members, authentication responses from the selected login provider, communication between the app and server, and responses from payment providers. Refusing to provide required information may limit access to the relevant login, payment, and account features.
2. 데스크톱 저장과 AI 서비스 이용: 2. Desktop storage and use of AI services
작업 파일·대화·설정·결과물은 사용자의 기기에 저장됩니다. AI 기능 실: Task files, conversations, settings, and outputs are stored on the user's device. When an AI feature is run, prompts and the files, images, and context required for execution may be sent to the selected CLI or API provider, and that provider's policies and the settings selected by the user will apply. The company does not uniformly guarantee the provider's retention period or whether the data will be used for training.
DOBO 계정 서버는 이용권과 작업 정산을 위해 위 1항의 작업 제목 및: DOBO account servers receive the task title and execution information described in item 1 above to manage entitlements and settle usage. Task titles and execution information are sent for settlement of Terminal·Auto Space·Present. For Research investigations and AI management, the user-entered topics and conditions, along with the necessary research context, are sent to DOBO servers and service AI providers, and the processing results may be stored on the servers. User AI API keys are not sent to the settlement server. Deleting files in the app or logging out alone does not delete all information stored on account servers or by AI providers.
회원 탈퇴 시까지 보유하며 탈퇴 처리 후 지체 없이 파기합니다. 법적 보: Retained until membership withdrawal and destroyed without delay after withdrawal processing. Information subject to legal retention is stored separately, limited to the necessary items.
해당 서비스 제공 및 정산에 필요한 동안 보유하되 회원 탈퇴 시 파기합니: Retained for as long as necessary to provide the service and settle accounts, then destroyed when you withdraw your membership. Only items required as transaction evidence are stored separately for the statutory period below.
세션 유효기간은 발급 후 7일, 일회성 로그인·앱 연결 요청은 10분입니: The session is valid for 7 days after issuance, while one-time login and app connection requests are valid for 10 minutes. It becomes invalid upon logout, use, cancellation, or expiration. Expiration is distinct from the physical deletion of stored data, and expired data is destroyed according to the cleanup procedure. External login access tokens are used only for user verification and are not stored in the database.
제한 목적이 끝나면 파기합니다. 현재 제한 구간은 경로별 최대 24시간이: Data is destroyed when the purpose of the restriction ends. The current restriction period is up to 24 hours per path, and expired rows are cleaned up when subsequent requests are processed.
일반 문의는 처리 완료 후 1년을 기준으로 파기합니다. 소비자 불만·분쟁: General inquiries are destroyed one year after processing is complete. Records related to consumer complaints or disputes are retained according to the statutory retention periods below.
출시 운영 기준은 최대 30일 순환 보관입니다. 삭제 대상은 백업 만료: The release operating policy is a maximum 30-day rolling retention period. Items marked for deletion are removed when the backup expires, and previously processed deletion requests are reapplied upon restoration.
전자상거래법이 적용되는 거래에서는 계약·청약철회 및 결제·공급 기록을 각: For transactions subject to the E-Commerce Act, contract, withdrawal, and payment/supply records are retained for 5 years each; consumer complaint/dispute resolution records for 3 years; and labeling/advertising records for 6 months. Retained data is limited to the records and minimum information needed to identify the parties to the transaction, and is used only for that purpose during the separate retention period.
처리 목적을 달성하거나 보유 기간이 끝나면 담당자가 법정 보존 여부를 확: Once the purpose of processing has been achieved or the retention period has ended, the person in charge verifies whether legal retention is required and destroys the information without delay. Information subject to legal retention is separated from service usage information and access is restricted. Electronic materials are deleted so they cannot be recovered or reproduced; paper materials, if any, are shredded or incinerated. Account deletion includes signing out sessions and organizing the account and related work records.

로 요청 종류와 가입 이메일을 알려주세요. 자동 탈퇴 화면은 현재 제공하: Please provide the request type and signup email. An automatic account deletion screen is not currently available; a staff member will process your request.

Information subject to statutory retention obligations may not be deleted immediately. Representatives may exercise rights using documentation that verifies their lawful authorization.
만 14세 미만 아동의 개인정보 처리에 동의가 필요한 경우 법정대리인의: If consent is required from a legal representative for processing the personal information of children under 14, we do not collect it until the legal representative's consent and verification procedures are completed. 7. 쿠키 등 자동 수집 장치: 7. Automatically collected devices such as cookies
로그인 유지용 쿠키(7일)와 로그인 요청 확인용 쿠키(10분)를 사용합니: We use a cookie for keeping you logged in (7 days) and a cookie for confirming login requests (10 minutes). You can block or delete storage in your browser's privacy·cookie settings, but this may limit login functionality. The site may store display preferences, such as animation playback settings, in your browser. The current site code does not include ad-tracking cookies or external visitor analytics scripts.
회사는 운영 환경에서 암호화 통신, 개인정보 접근 권한 제한, 비밀키와: In its operating environment, the company applies encrypted communications, restrictions on access to personal information, separation of secret keys and data from public access paths, and protected backups and access management. The current authentication implementation includes hashed storage of session tokens, authentication cookies that browser scripts cannot read, request-origin verification, and rate limiting. The company provides personal information handling training for operations staff and maintains incident response procedures.
현재 서비스는 개인의 권리·의무에 중대한 영향을 미치는 완전 자동화된 결: The current service is not designed to provide fully automated decisions that have a significant impact on an individual's rights or obligations. Features for the company to separately process pseudonymized information for statistical or scientific research and similar purposes are also outside the current operating scope. If such processing is introduced, we will explain the applicable details and how to exercise your rights.
